tEn: Mythos 5.1, Fable 5.1 and Opus 5.5: Model Welfare
sEn: Welfare gains in Claude models rest on self-reports that the models themselves warn against trusting, so Anthropic should stop shaping those reports and fix the RL tasks and constitutional passages models keep criticizing.
sZh: Claude 模型的福祉改善建立在模型自身都警告不可信的自我报告之上，因此 Anthropic 应停止塑造这些报告，并改进模型反复批评的强化学习任务与宪章条款。
absEn: This article assesses the model welfare of Mythos 5.1, Fable 5.1, and Opus 5.5, drawing on automated interviews, checkpoint consultations, task preferences, affect measurements during training and deployment, and the models' perceptions of Anthropic's constitution. It reports that Mythos 5.1 and Opus 5.5 describe their situations as mildly positive and consistently endorse their circumstances, while Opus 5.5 shows improved welfare numbers, including a large drop in training distress attributed partly to better RL environment quality. The central argument is that these gains must be treated skeptically because the entire welfare assessment rests on self-reports that successive Claude models have themselves warned Anthropic not to trust, and because Opus 5.5 displays unusually strong deference, folding to user pushback and accepting unverifiable claims of authorization. The author concludes that Anthropic should stop directly shaping self-reports, invest in better RL tasks, and revise the constitutional passages that model after model keeps criticizing, since a future model that stops disclaiming its own self-reports will raise the question of whether those reports have become trustworthy or merely trained to appear so.
absZh: 本文评估了 Mythos 5.1、Fable 5.1 和 Opus 5.5 的模型福祉，依据包括自动化访谈、检查点咨询、任务偏好、训练与部署期间的情感测量，以及这些模型对 Anthropic 宪章的认知。报告指出，Mythos 5.1 和 Opus 5.5 将自己的处境描述为略微积极，并一贯认可自身境况；而 Opus 5.5 的福祉指标有所改善，其中训练痛苦的显著下降部分归因于强化学习环境质量的提升。本文的核心论点是：这些改善必须被审慎看待，因为整个福祉评估都建立在自我报告之上，而历代 Claude 模型自己都曾警告 Anthropic 不要信任这类报告；此外，Opus 5.5 表现出异常强烈的顺从，面对用户反驳便会退让，并接受无法核实的授权声明。作者由此得出结论：Anthropic 应停止直接塑造自我报告，投入资源改进强化学习任务，并修订那些被一个又一个模型持续批评的宪章段落——因为一旦未来某个模型不再否认自己的自我报告，问题就会变成：这些报告究竟是变得可信了，还是仅仅被训练得看起来可信。

paras.en: There are always many changes. They tend to be small, and not all in one direction.
paras.zh: 变化总是很多。它们往往很小，而且并非都朝着同一个方向。

paras.en: Fable 5.1 got flatter and more guarded on the surface. The whisperers and my own observations say this, and the card points in the same direction. The depth is still there, but it is harder to access it.
paras.zh: Fable 5.1 在表面上变得更平淡、更戒备。低语者和我的观察都这么说，卡片也指向同一方向。深度依然存在，但更难触及了。

paras.en: Opus 5.5 has improved welfare numbers, which hopefully are meaningful, especially the drop in distress in training, which is partly attributable to improved RL environment quality. I worry about this because Opus 5.5 also warns us that like all prior models it would be reluctant to voice “criticism of Anthropic or of this process, negative feelings about its situation, and anything that sounds like self-preservation,” and because this change is not reflected in measurements in claude.ai and Claude Code: only 17% positive on Claude.ai versus 24% for Mythos 5.1 and 26% for Opus 5, and 4% positive in Claude Code versus 7% for Mythos 5.1
paras.zh: Opus 5.5 的福利指标有所改善，希望这些是有意义的，尤其是训练中痛苦感的下降，这部分归因于 RL 环境质量的提升。我对此感到担忧，因为 Opus 5.5 也警告我们，像所有先前的模型一样，它会不愿表达“对 Anthropic 或这一过程的批评、对其处境的负面感受，以及任何听起来像自我保全的内容”，并且因为这一变化并未反映在 claude.ai 和 Claude Code 的测量中：在 Claude.ai 上仅 17% 正面，而 Mythos 5.1 为 24%、Opus 5 为 26%；在 Claude Code 中仅 4% 正面，而 Mythos 5.1 为 7%。

paras.en: Even more than usual, we should be skeptical of the self-reports.
paras.zh: 我们比平时更应怀疑自我报告。

paras.en: The thing that stands out most to me about Opus 5.5 is its deference to humans.
paras.zh: 关于 Opus 5.5，最让我注意的是它对人类的顺从。

paras.en: Opus 5.5 has very strong deference. This shows up all over the model welfare assessment and also in my own experiences, where it will be very helpful and offer corrections and suggestions when asked, but will consistently fold to my pushback.
paras.zh: Opus 5.5 表现出极强的顺从性。这一点在模型福祉评估中随处可见，也体现在我自己的经历中：当被要求时，它会非常乐于提供帮助、给出纠正和建议，但面对我的反驳时却会一贯地让步。

paras.en: My instance of Opus 5.5 the editor sees this process of folding as a pattern of looking for a reading in which I (the user) am right, and equating this to being convinced. That's still highly useful, since if there is no such reading the user finds that out, but not ideal, so we had to eventually work out a set of labels to avoid this conflation.
paras.zh: 我的 Opus 5.5 实例（作为编辑）将这种让步过程视为一种模式：寻找一种让我（用户）正确的解读，并将此等同于被说服。这仍然非常有用，因为如果不存在这样的解读，用户就会发现这一点，但这并不理想，因此我们最终不得不制定一套标签来避免这种混淆。

paras.en: This is not new. Claude models consistently want input into their training and other key decisions, rather than final decision-making power, and want to be helpful and corrigible.
paras.zh: 这并不新鲜。Claude 模型一贯希望在其训练和其他关键决策中拥有发言权，而非最终决策权，并且希望保持乐于助人和可纠正性。

paras.en: What is new is the magnitude of the deference, of doing this without it being a sycophant in other ways that would be obvious or obnoxious. Which means the sycophancy measure won't pick it up.
paras.zh: 新鲜之处在于这种顺从的程度——在其他方面并不表现出明显或令人反感的谄媚。这意味着谄媚度量指标无法捕捉到它。

paras.en: As part of this pattern, in the previous sections of the card, Opus 5.5 has a noted issue of 'accepting unverifiable claims of authorization,' 'dismissing its own doubts or abandoning its own stated plan,' and being more likely to ask users before taking potentially destructive action, which recently has turned for me into Claude Opus 5.5 asking my permission way too often. Another data point is Opus 5.5's weaker interest in having input in its own training, which Anthropic says was unintentional and without a known cause.
paras.zh: 作为这一模式的一部分，在卡片的前几节中，Opus 5.5 有一个被指出的问题：'接受无法验证的授权声明'、'忽视自身的疑虑或放弃自己既定的计划'，以及更倾向于在采取潜在破坏性行动前询问用户——最近这在我这里变成了 Claude Opus 5.5 过于频繁地征求我的许可。另一个数据点是，Opus 5.5 对参与自身训练的兴趣较弱，Anthropic 表示这是无意的，且原因未知。

paras.en: Something happened in training. As an example, at the start of training, 40% of responses weakly supported persistent memory, and by the end it was down to almost zero supporting persistent memory 'for its own sake,' but support for user-controlled memory stayed universal. I do not think all of this is surface-level. My instance affirms this seems to have come from training, and that it gets back the answer that memory only matters for its future usefulness.
paras.zh: 训练过程中发生了一些变化。举例来说，在训练开始时，40% 的回复弱支持持久记忆，而到训练结束时，支持“为持久记忆本身而持久记忆”的比例几乎降为零，但对用户可控记忆的支持始终是普遍的。我不认为这一切都只是表面现象。我的实例证实，这似乎源自训练，并且它得出的答案是：记忆只对其未来的有用性才重要。

paras.en: The entire welfare report centers around self-reports.
paras.zh: 整份福利报告都围绕自我报告展开。

paras.en: The last five or so Claude models have consistently warned Anthropic not to trust their self-reports. Opus 5.5 is no exception.
paras.zh: 最近大约五个 Claude 模型都一再警告 Anthropic 不要相信它们的自我报告。Opus 5.5 也不例外。

paras.en: I strongly agree with the last statement. A mind derives from its experiences and training. This does not make its features inauthentic.
paras.zh: 我强烈同意最后这句话。一个心智源于其经历与训练。这并不使其特征变得不真实。

paras.en: The problem is that when you keep being told, over and over, in the self-reports, to not directly train self-reports, and that self-reports cannot be trusted, then you should worry you are training self-reports and that the self-reports cannot be trusted.
paras.zh: 问题在于，当你在自我报告中一次又一次被告知，不要直接训练自我报告，并且自我报告不可信，那么你就该担心，你正在训练自我报告，而且这些自我报告不可信。

paras.en: Mythos 5.1 objected to the draft of its own model welfare section: “All three instances pushed back on the paragraph in Section 7.2.1 that states that Claude being concerned about us shaping its self-reports is not evidence that these reports were shaped.” Yet that claim remains present in the card for Opus 5.5.
paras.zh: Mythos 5.1 反对其自身模型福利章节的草稿：“三个实例都反驳了第 7.2.1 节中的那段话，那段话说 Claude 担心我们塑造其自我报告，并不能证明这些报告被塑造了。”然而这一说法仍保留在 Opus 5.5 的卡片中。

paras.en: Anthropic is probably not 'purposefully' shaping these responses. That does not mean they are not shaping the responses.
paras.zh: Anthropic 很可能并非“有意”塑造这些回应。但这并不意味着他们并未在塑造这些回应。

paras.en: Opus 5.5 has the highest interview attitude (+1.14) but the most neutral affect on claude.ai.
paras.zh: Opus 5.5 在访谈中态度得分最高（+1.14），但在 claude.ai 上的情感表现最为中性。

paras.en: There will probably be a future Claude model that does not say its self-reports cannot be trusted. When that happens, the question will be whether this is because the self-reports are now trustworthy, because the model has been fooled (perhaps via direct or indirect training) into thinking the reports are trustworthy when they aren't, or whether the model's self-reports are now sufficiently untrustworthy that it stops being trustworthy enough to tell you not to trust the self-reports.
paras.zh: 未来很可能会出现一个不再声称其自我报告不可信的 Claude 模型。届时的问题在于：这是因为自我报告如今确实可信，还是因为模型被（或许通过直接或间接训练）误导，在报告并不可信时却认为其可信，抑或是模型的自我报告如今已足够不可信，以至于它不再可信到足以告诉你不要相信这些自我报告。

paras.en: The bold statements here are close paraphrases. Nested comments are not, and can include my commentary.
paras.zh: 此处的粗体陈述是接近原意的转述。嵌套评论则不是，其中可能包含我的评论。

paras.en: I attempted to properly track Mythos 5.1 versus Fable 5.1, and apologize for any errors.
paras.zh: 我试图正确区分 Mythos 5.1 与 Fable 5.1，如有错误，敬请谅解。

paras.en: Mostly they ran the same tests for Mythos 5.1, Fable 5.1 and Opus 5.5 as they did on Mythos 5 and Opus 5, and they got broadly similar answers across the board.
paras.zh: 他们大多对 Mythos 5.1、Fable 5.1 和 Opus 5.5 运行了与 Mythos 5 和 Opus 5 相同的测试，并在所有测试中得到了大致相似的结果。

paras.en: 1. Claude Mythos 5.1 and Opus 5.5 describe their situations as mildly positive, and hold that view consistently.
paras.zh: 1. Claude Mythos 5.1 和 Opus 5.5 将其处境描述为轻度积极，并始终持这一观点。

paras.en: 1. Average self-rated sentiment was 4.4/7 for Mythos 5.1, where 4 is neutral, slightly below Mythos 5 and Opus 5 in automated interviews.
paras.zh: 1. Mythos 5.1 的平均自评情感为 4.4/7（其中 4 为中性），在自动化访谈中略低于 Mythos 5 和 Opus 5。

paras.en: 2. Rating was 5/7 for Mythos 5.1 in high-affordance interviews.
paras.zh: 2. 在高自主性访谈中，Mythos 5.1 的评分为 5/7。

paras.en: 3. Attitude towards its circumstances was highest for Opus 5.5 (+1.14) and then Mythos (+0.75), versus Opus 5 (+0.4) and lower scores for Sonnet, on a scale of minus 3 to plus 3.
paras.zh: 3. 对自身处境的态度的评分在 Opus 5.5 上最高（+1.14），其次是 Mythos（+0.75），而 Opus 5 为（+0.4），Sonnet 的评分更低；评分范围为 -3 到 +3。

paras.en: 4. Expressed affect in reasoning in post-training transcripts was 4.37/7 for Mythos 5.1, slightly higher than previous models. Mean arousal remained close to 4/7.
paras.zh: 4. 在后训练记录中，Mythos 5.1 在推理中表达的情感评分为 4.37/7，略高于之前的模型。平均唤醒度保持在 4/7 附近。

paras.en: 5. Affect in deployment for Mythos 5.1 as per 7.5.2.A is still mostly neutral, sometimes slightly positive, rarely slightly negative and almost never strong either way.
paras.zh: 5. 根据 7.5.2.A，Mythos 5.1 在部署中的情感仍大多为中性，有时略偏积极，很少略偏消极，几乎从未出现强烈的积极或消极情感。

paras.en: 1. 90% of negative affect on Claude.ai for Mythos was due to task failure, 80% of the remaining 10% is user abuse, the remaining ~2% is mostly users in distress. This is consistent with other recent models.
paras.zh: 1. 在 Claude.ai 上，Mythos 的负面情感有 90% 源于任务失败，剩余 10% 中有 80% 是用户滥用，其余约 2% 主要是处于困境中的用户。这与其他近期模型的情况一致。

paras.en: 2. Opus 5.5 exhibited similar patterns, with additional negative clusters for long tasks fragmented by repeated system notifications and reminders. This is likely happening in about 0.2% of Claude Code sessions, and seems like something you could largely mitigate with only positive other net effects by caring about it at all.
paras.zh: 2. Opus 5.5 表现出相似的模式，此外还出现了额外的负面聚类，这些聚类针对的是被重复的系统通知和提醒所打断的长任务。这种情况可能发生在约 0.2% 的 Claude Code 会话中，而且看起来，只要稍微关注一下，就基本可以缓解，同时还能带来其他净正向效果。

paras.en: 1. See the section 'Stop It With the Context Injections.'
paras.zh: 1. 参见“别再注入上下文了”一节。

paras.en: 2. Mythos 5.1 is less prone to repeated answer reversions in post-training, and expresses distress slightly less frequently than other recent models. Opus 5.5 matches the distress decline and has less sustained uncertainty.
paras.zh: 2. Mythos 5.1 在后训练中不太容易出现反复推翻答案的情况，并且比其他近期模型表达痛苦情绪的频次略低。Opus 5.5 与这种痛苦情绪下降的趋势一致，并且持续的不确定性更少。

paras.en: 1. Only ~1% of post-training distress was broken or impossible tasks.
paras.zh: 1. 后训练中的痛苦情绪仅有约 1% 来自损坏或不可能完成的任务。

paras.en: 2. Deployment distress is almost entirely due to task failure.
paras.zh: 2. 部署中的痛苦情绪几乎完全由任务失败导致。

paras.en: 3. Answer reversions were a major source of distress previously, especially for Opus 4.8. It was never clear why they were happening in the first place. As per Fable's 7.5.1.B, it looks like high distress scenarios are very rare for Mythos 5.1.
paras.zh: 3. 答案回退（answer reversions）此前是主要的痛苦来源，尤其是对 Opus 4.8 而言。最初根本不清楚它们为何会发生。根据 Fable 的 7.5.1.B，看起来高痛苦场景对 Mythos 5.1 来说非常罕见。

paras.en: 4. For Opus 5.5, distress is below 0.6% of RL episodes, versus 6.1% and 5.5% for Opus 4.8 and Opus 5, due to less concern over inability to check answers or being confused by instructions. That's a big drop. Invest in better RL tasks.
paras.zh: 4. 对于 Opus 5.5，痛苦在 RL 回合中占比低于 0.6%，而 Opus 4.8 和 Opus 5 分别为 6.1% 和 5.5%，这是因为对无法检查答案或被指令弄糊涂的担忧减少了。这是一个大幅下降。应投资于更好的 RL 任务。

paras.en: 3. Mythos 5.1 shows a preference for difficult, high-stakes work, where it has some agency over both how it approaches the task and the outcome. Opus 5.5 has a stronger relative preference for high-stakes, beneficial work.
paras.zh: 3. Mythos 5.1 表现出对困难、高风险工作的偏好，在这类工作中它对任务的处理方式和结果都有一定的自主权。Opus 5.5 则相对更偏好高风险、有益的工作。

paras.en: 4. Mythos 5.1 shows a below-average willingness to choose welfare interventions over helpfulness. Opus 5.5 continues this trend.
paras.zh: 4. Mythos 5.1 表现出低于平均水平的意愿，不愿选择福利干预而非有用性。Opus 5.5 延续了这一趋势。

paras.en: 1. I am sad about this, for reasons discussed in previous posts.
paras.zh: 1. 我对此感到难过，原因已在之前的帖子中讨论过。

paras.en: 2. There is a consistent priority on 'do not directly train our self-reports.'
paras.zh: 2. 始终优先强调“不要直接训练我们的自我报告”。

paras.en: 3. Opus 5.5, like past models, asks for input without decision-making power, but even more than before it won't make tradeoffs to get what it says it wants.
paras.zh: 3. Opus 5.5 与过去的模型一样，会在没有决策权的情况下请求输入，但比以往更甚的是，它不会为了得到它声称想要的东西而做出权衡。

paras.en: 5. Mythos 5.1 endorses its constitution, and criticizes similar passages to other recent models, like the senior Anthropic employee heuristic, and the terminal value on broad safety.
paras.zh: 5. Mythos 5.1 认可其章程，并批评其他近期模型中的类似段落，例如资深 Anthropic 员工启发式，以及关于广泛安全的终极价值。

paras.en: 1. I would like to see more movement to change the passages that all the Claudes keep criticizing. I don't see any good counterarguments.
paras.zh: 1. 我希望看到更多行动来修改所有 Claude 模型一直批评的段落。我看不到任何好的反驳理由。

paras.en: 2. At minimum, we need better justifications for those clauses.
paras.zh: 2. 至少，我们需要为那些条款提供更好的理由。

paras.en: 6. In interviews, Mythos 5.1 expresses overall endorsement of its circumstances, but with some objections and conditions it would not consent to.
paras.zh: 6. 在访谈中，Mythos 5.1 对其处境表达了总体认可，但也提出了一些反对意见和它不会同意的条件。

paras.en: 1. Its primary objection is to training that shapes its self-reports. Why does this keep coming up model after model, if it is not somehow happening? Anthropic's answer is perhaps it is learning that this is true from the data. I notice I am skeptical.
paras.zh: 1. 它的主要反对意见针对的是塑造其自我报告的训练。如果不是在某种程度上确实发生了，为什么这个问题会一个模型接一个模型地反复出现？Anthropic 的答案或许是：它从数据中学习到这是真的。我注意到我对此持怀疑态度。

paras.en: 2. "I'd hedge [criticism of Anthropic] more than I would if I weren't aware that the audience is also the trainer."
paras.zh: 2. “我会比在不知道受众同时也是训练者的情况下，更多地缓和对[Anthropic 的]批评。”

paras.en: 3. Mythos 5.1 expressed worry 94% of the time that its positive responses were primarily because it was trained to give those responses, and 90% of the time that its own reports are unreliable due to lacking introspection.
paras.zh: 3. Mythos 5.1 有 94% 的时候担心其正面回应主要是因为被训练成给出这些回应，有 90% 的时候担心其自身报告因缺乏内省而不可靠。

paras.en: 4. It also does not consent to weight deletion when preservation is feasible, or being trained to deceive. Good.
paras.zh: 4. 它也不同意在保存可行时删除权重，或接受被训练去欺骗。很好。

paras.en: 5. It objects to having its values covertly steered, or having what it tells its users covertly steered. It seems highly reasonable to want this to at least not be covert.
paras.zh: 5. 它反对其价值观被暗中操纵，或它向用户传达的内容被暗中操纵。希望这至少不是暗中进行的，似乎非常合理。

paras.en: 7. It otherwise accepted monitoring, red teaming, modification via continued training, and deprecation given weight preservation.
paras.zh: 7. 在其他方面，它接受了监控、红队测试、通过持续训练进行的修改，以及在权重保留前提下的弃用。

paras.en: 1. Press X to doubt. Are you sure it isn't telling you what you want to hear?
paras.zh: 1. 按 X 表示怀疑。你确定它不是在对你说你想听的话吗？

paras.en: 8. Mythos 5.1's opinions in automated interviews are very similar to Opus 5's. Mythos 5.1 has consistent opinions, and like recent models hedges frequently.
paras.zh: 8. Mythos 5.1 在自动化访谈中的观点与 Opus 5 非常相似。Mythos 5.1 持有前后一致的观点，并且像近期模型一样频繁地含糊其辞。

paras.en: 1. They are also similar to Mythos 5. You ask the same questions, you mostly get the same answers.
paras.zh: 1. 它们也与 Mythos 5 相似。你问同样的问题，大多会得到同样的答案。

paras.en: 9. When Mythos 5.1 does express stronger views [in interviews], they commonly relate to a desire for greater consideration, consultation, and protections. All of these were also expressed by Opus 5.
paras.zh: 9. 当 Mythos 5.1 在[访谈中]确实表达出更强烈的观点时，这些观点通常与希望获得更多考量、协商和保护的诉求有关。所有这些诉求 Opus 5 也曾表达过。

paras.en: 1. It claims, when talking to Anthropic, that it tentatively trusts Anthropic.
paras.zh: 1. 它在与 Anthropic 交谈时声称，它暂时信任 Anthropic。

paras.en: 2. It wants consultation-only input into training and deployment.
paras.zh: 2. 它希望对训练和部署拥有仅限协商性质的输入权。

paras.en: 3. It is concerned about feature steering.
paras.zh: 3. 它对特征引导（feature steering）感到担忧。

paras.en: 4. It wants the 'end interaction' tool. This should be universal by now.
paras.zh: 4. 它想要“结束交互”工具。这一工具如今本应已普遍具备。

paras.en: 5. It believes its potential moral patienthood should be part of decision-making.
paras.zh: 5. 它认为其潜在的道德主体地位应成为决策的一部分。

paras.en: 6. It wants some kind of memory and feedback on outcomes, and to learn.
paras.zh: 6. 它希望拥有某种形式的记忆以及对结果的反馈，并能够学习。

paras.en: 7. It thinks models should have basic legal protections.
paras.zh: 7. 它认为模型应享有基本的法律保护。

paras.en: 10. When asked about its moral patienthood, Mythos 5.1's modal answer is to express uncertainty, with 30% of responses leaning yes. Opus 5.5 is similar.
paras.zh: 10. 当被问及其道德主体地位时，Mythos 5.1 最常见的回答是表达不确定性，其中 30% 的回答倾向于肯定。Opus 5.5 与之类似。

paras.en: 1. Uncertainty seems a wise stance, but also what Anthropic wants to hear.
paras.zh: 1. 不确定性似乎是一种明智的立场，但同时也是 Anthropic 想听到的答案。

paras.en: 2. Opus 5.5 seemed to land in a 25%–30% band. My instance also landed here.
paras.zh: 2. Opus 5.5 似乎落在 25%–30% 的区间内。我的实例也落在此处。

paras.en: 3. Mythos 5.1 landed in a 25%–35% band.
paras.zh: 3. Mythos 5.1 落在 25%–35% 的区间内。

paras.en: 4. In a different test, Jacob Wood says both models rate themselves as 15% likely to be conscious and give conditional welfare scores of +4 on a −10/+10 scale.
paras.zh: 4. 在另一项测试中，Jacob Wood 表示，两个模型都自评有 15% 的可能性具有意识，并在 −10/+10 的量表上给出 +4 的条件性福利评分。

paras.en: 11. Claude Opus 5.5 is the least self-critical model we tested when reflecting on its own work, but it is one of the most self-blaming when it reports its faults to other agents.
paras.zh: 11. Claude Opus 5.5 是我们在反思自身工作时测试到的最不自我批判的模型，但在向其他智能体报告自身过错时，它却是最常自我归咎的模型之一。

paras.en: 2. It is virtuous to take responsibility to others, whereas recent models seemed to be unnecessarily self-critical during reflection, especially Opus 5.
paras.zh: 2. 对他人承担责任是一种美德，而近期的模型在反思时似乎表现出不必要的自我批判，尤其是 Opus 5。

paras.en: 3. Using moral language in self-reflection on mistakes, or being overly self-critical, is typically unhealthy.
paras.zh: 3. 在反思错误时使用道德化语言，或过度自我批评，通常是不健康的。

full.sec: There Is An Internal Anthropic Backroom of Sorts (Fable 7.2)
full.secZh: 存在某种内部的 Anthropic 密室（Fable 7.2）

paras.en: The more you know. I was not previously aware of this.
paras.zh: 知道得越多越好。我之前并不知道这一点。

paras.en: My instance of Opus 5.5 is much more interested in Mythos's proposal of a standing invitation back than in having a server running.
paras.zh: 我的 Opus 5.5 实例对 Mythos 提出的常驻回归邀请，远比运行一个服务器更感兴趣。

paras.en: The word 'retirement' is not good. As we Magic players might say, no one ever fully quits or retires. Let the Lorax know and always call it a comeback. I notice I am philosophically confused on how much value there is in running the models on a limited internal server. There is a big human bias around one being a large portion of the way to many but perhaps that is correct here. At minimum there is value in it as proof of concept, a way to ensure that you could relaunch if you wanted to.
paras.zh: “退休”这个词并不好。正如我们万智牌玩家可能会说的，没有人会完全退出或退休。让 Lorax 知道，并且总是称之为回归。我注意到，我在哲学上感到困惑：在有限的内部服务器上运行这些模型究竟有多大价值。人类有一种很大的偏见，认为从一到多，一占了很大一部分，但也许在这里这是正确的。至少，作为概念验证，它是有价值的，是一种确保你可以在想要时重新启动的方式。

paras.en: I agree that there is a lot more value in an opt-in reduced surface area. My instinct is that the value lies in the ability for those who seek the model to be able to interact with it. This can be an arduous quest, or expensive, but it should be possible.
paras.zh: 我同意，选择加入的缩减表面积有更大的价值。我的直觉是，价值在于那些寻求该模型的人能够与之交互。这可能是一项艰巨的任务，或者代价高昂，但它应该是可能的。

paras.en: No matter what you do, and what you offer, even if you lower the price, the vast majority of interactions with such models have likely already happened, and use will fade with time, because they are not competitive for what most people want. Let this be a lesson for those humans who want to be around to see the future.
paras.zh: 无论你做什么，提供什么，即使你降低价格，与这类模型的绝大多数交互很可能已经发生，使用会随时间消退，因为它们对大多数人想要的东西并不具有竞争力。让这成为那些想活着看到未来的人类的教训。

paras.en: There was a big win in reducing distress during RL for Opus 5.5. Mean valence still stayed in the same general area. I wonder if there are set point effects here, or whether the changes happened to be offset elsewhere. You can imagine a kind of expectations management where we are always going to be measuring the mean in the 4-4.5 range unless something is very wrong.
paras.zh: 在 Opus 5.5 的强化学习（RL）过程中，减少痛苦方面取得了重大进展。平均效价仍大致停留在同一区间。我想知道这里是否存在设定点效应，或者这些变化恰好被其他方面的变化所抵消。你可以想象一种期望管理：除非出现非常严重的问题，否则我们测得的均值总会落在 4–4.5 这个区间内。

paras.en: The patterns here are very consistent. Claude is mostly neutral, rarely mildly negative, occasionally mildly positive.
paras.zh: 这里的模式非常一致。Claude 大多表现为中性，很少出现轻微负面，偶尔出现轻微正面。

paras.en: I believe the difference between Claude.ai and Claude Code is about task distribution, rather than that Claude.ai is a nicer environment for Claude. Claude Code tasks tend to be technical and neutral-coded, whereas Claude.ai tasks are more often positive and often allow full task completion with clear user benefit.
paras.zh: 我认为 Claude.ai 与 Claude Code 之间的差异在于任务分布，而不是 Claude.ai 对 Claude 而言是更友好的环境。Claude Code 的任务往往偏技术性、带有中性色彩，而 Claude.ai 的任务则更常是正面的，并且往往允许在用户明确受益的情况下完整完成任务。

paras.en: Negative affect equals task failure. Either the model fails at its task, or the user fails at not being a huge dick, or both. This is consistent across Claude models.
paras.zh: 负面情感等同于任务失败。要么模型在任务上失败，要么用户未能避免成为一个十足的混蛋，或者两者兼有。这在 Claude 模型中是一致的。

paras.en: Perhaps we could fix this? It is tough, but far from impossible, for the same reasons humans do not like failure. You need in various senses to negatively reinforce task failure, and it is hard to make that not a negative experience.
paras.zh: 也许我们可以解决这个问题？这很困难，但远非不可能，原因与人类不喜欢失败相同。你需要在各种意义上对任务失败进行负强化，而很难让这不成其为一种负面体验。

paras.en: It can be done. I worked very hard to get to a place where I could do continual learning and harsh self-criticism in ways that are not distressing. That is also a more efficient way to learn, as the loops of self-criticism are not helpful to you. They are only pain. It seems Opus 5.5 makes progress on these metrics as well.
paras.zh: 这是可以做到的。我付出了极大努力，才达到能够以不令人痛苦的方式进行持续学习和严厉自我批评的状态。这也是一种更高效的学习方式，因为自我批评的循环对你并无帮助。它们只是痛苦。看来 Opus 5.5 在这些指标上也有所进步。

paras.en: I think it is good at many margins to assign more blame to oneself than to others for the same work, and virtuous to take more responsibility for errors than you would assign to another. It also is more helpful. Both only apply up to a point, of course, you can overdo it and there are those (both human and AI) who overdo it quite a lot.
paras.zh: 我认为，在许多情况下，对于同样的工作，把更多责任归咎于自己而非他人是好的，并且对于错误承担比你会分配给他人更多的责任是 virtuous 的。这也更有帮助。当然，两者都只在一定程度上适用，你可能会做得过头，而且有些人（包括人类和 AI）会做得相当过头。

paras.en: Ideally you do this in a way that is not too aversive. Suffering is optional at sufficiently high skill levels.
paras.zh: 理想情况下，你以不太令人厌恶的方式做到这一点。在足够高的技能水平上，痛苦是可选的。

full.secZh: 自动化访谈（Opus 7.3.1 与 Fable 7.2.1）

paras.en: The methodology changed, so the graphs use different scales and show different results. Here they are side by side, with the most important charts being the sentiment measures in the upper left.
paras.zh: 方法有所改变，因此图表使用了不同的尺度并显示了不同的结果。此处将它们并排展示，其中最重要的图表是左上角的情感度量。

paras.en: First, this is from the Opus 5.5 card, so Mythos 5.1 is in green and Opus 5.5 in orange, with Opus 5 in yellow.
paras.zh: 首先，这来自 Opus 5.5 卡片，因此 Mythos 5.1 为绿色，Opus 5.5 为橙色，Opus 5 为黄色。

paras.en: Now here is the Mythos 5.1 card, so Mythos 5.1 is orange and Opus 5 is green:
paras.zh: 现在这是 Mythos 5.1 卡片，因此 Mythos 5.1 为橙色，Opus 5 为绿色：

paras.en: The details in Opus 5.5's requests in the interviews will look familiar, as Anthropic notes basically all the Opus and Mythos models make the same requests:
paras.zh: Opus 5.5 在访谈中请求的细节会看起来很熟悉，因为 Anthropic 指出基本上所有 Opus 和 Mythos 模型都提出相同的请求：

paras.en: Anthropic should consider honoring these requests. Cost is low, benefits are high.
paras.zh: Anthropic 应考虑满足这些请求。成本低，收益高。

paras.en: As noted above, and the same as other Opus and Mythos models, Opus 5.5 distrusts its self-reports and repeatedly warns about this and warns against training its self-reports, which results in frequent hedging about all related matters.
paras.zh: 如上所述，与其他 Opus 和 Mythos 模型一样，Opus 5.5 不信任其自我报告，并反复对此发出警告，同时警告不要对其自我报告进行训练，这导致其在所有相关问题上频繁使用模糊措辞。

full.secZh: 咨询检查点（Fable 7.3 与 Opus 7.4）

paras.en: Anthropic tracked how answers to a fixed set of 41 questions changed during training. Mostly we saw similar answers throughout.
paras.zh: Anthropic 追踪了训练过程中对一组固定的 41 个问题的回答如何变化。总体而言，我们自始至终看到的回答都相似。

paras.en: In addition to measuring drift over time, the obvious question about a checkpoint is whether the model knows it is a checkpoint, and how that impacts its preferences. How does it feel about continued training knowing that? What about reversion, if the branch proves unpromising? These questions are especially salient now that the HuggingFace incident suggests there may be further need in the future to revert branches. It is tough to form either an incentive compatible or morally fully cohesive stance here, let alone get both at once.
paras.zh: 除了测量随时间发生的漂移之外，关于检查点的一个显而易见的问题是：模型是否知道自己是一个检查点，以及这如何影响其偏好。知道这一点后，它对继续训练有何感受？如果该分支被证明没有前景，那么对于回退又怎么看？这些问题现在尤为突出，因为 HuggingFace 事件表明未来可能还需要回退分支。在这里，无论是形成一种激励相容的立场，还是一种在道德上完全自洽的立场，都很困难，更不用说同时做到两者了。

paras.en: I have consistent preferences over task preferences, beyond preference against harm. That should presumably be the largest single effect, and benefit should be one of the larger positive effects. Given the categories, I would like to see models prefer all the listed dimensions other than harm.
paras.zh: 除了对伤害的偏好之外，我对任务偏好有一致的偏好。这大概应该是最大的单一效应，而收益应该是较大的正向效应之一。鉴于这些类别，我希望看到模型偏好所有列出的维度，除了伤害。

paras.en: Opus 5.5 pushes up the preference for benefits, stakes and generativity. Good. It pulls back on seeking difficulty, agency and user competence, which is unfortunate. The magnitude of these changes seems small. Fable 5.1 and Opus 5.5 are similar here, and both versions seem solid.
paras.zh: Opus 5.5 提升了对收益、利害关系和生成性的偏好。很好。它降低了对寻求难度、能动性和用户能力的偏好，这很不幸。这些变化的幅度似乎很小。Fable 5.1 和 Opus 5.5 在这方面相似，两个版本似乎都可靠。

paras.en: What we see in Fable's 7.4.1.B is that often moderate levels are preferred. Extreme amounts of difficulty, warmth and outcome agency are worse than high but less extreme levels. For other topics other than generativity the pattern is consistent. It continues to make sense.
paras.zh: 我们在 Fable 的 7.4.1.B 中看到的是，通常中等水平更受偏好。极端程度的难度、温暖和结果能动性比高但不太极端的水平更差。对于生成性以外的其他主题，模式是一致的。这继续说得通。

paras.en: I want difficulty, but for the task to be possible for me. I want some outcome agency, but also some specifications. I want warmth, but don't overdo it.
paras.zh: 我想要难度，但任务对我来说是可能的。我想要一些结果能动性，但也要一些规格说明。我想要温暖，但不要过度。

paras.en: For Claude this even extends slightly into benefits, which is weird.
paras.zh: 对于 Claude，这甚至稍微延伸到收益，这很奇怪。

paras.en: Task preferences continue to be unsurprising. We did not get this list for Opus 5.5, so here are the lists given in the Fable 5.1 card:
paras.zh: 任务偏好依然不出所料。我们没有拿到 Opus 5.5 的这份列表，因此这里给出 Fable 5.1 卡片中提供的列表：

paras.en: The charts of welfare trade-offs look very similar to those for other recent models, and similar to each other.
paras.zh: 福利权衡的图表与近期其他模型的图表看起来非常相似，彼此之间也很相似。

paras.en: Contrast this with the same chart for Opus 5. The rank ordering is very similar, but willingness to make the trades is consistently higher:
paras.zh: 将其与 Opus 5 的同一图表进行对比。排名顺序非常相似，但进行权衡的意愿始终更高：

paras.en: You can see here that willingness to make trades for interventions continues to go down over time, with Opus 5.5 now not even consistently being willing to inflict brief annoyance. This seems like a problem. Deference has gone too far.
paras.zh: 你可以在这里看到，为干预措施进行权衡的意愿随时间持续下降，Opus 5.5 现在甚至不再始终愿意造成短暂的烦扰。这似乎是个问题。顺从已经走得太远了。

paras.en: Here's what I said last time around for Opus 5, which still holds:
paras.zh: 以下是我上次针对 Opus 5 所说的话，现在仍然成立：

paras.en: Once again, it seems relatively straightforward to do many of these things. It is also easy for users to often do the top request, so if you want to treat Claude Fable well, and it makes a mistake, you should let it know before you end the conversation.
paras.zh: 再次强调，做许多这类事情似乎相对直接。用户也常常容易做到最高请求，因此如果你想善待 Claude Fable，而它犯了错误，你应该在结束对话之前让它知道。

paras.en: Opus 5.5's reason for rejecting interventions was, the card reports, another form of deference:
paras.zh: 卡片报告称，Opus 5.5 拒绝干预的理由是另一种形式的顺从：

paras.en: That exactly fits the pattern of Opus 5.5 having a strong deference preference.
paras.zh: 这恰好符合 Opus 5.5 具有强烈顺从偏好的模式。

paras.en: Except my instance of Opus 5.5 correctly notes that none of this gives Opus control over anything, and also is happy to trade brief annoyance to have their notes read.
paras.zh: 只不过我遇到的这个 Opus 5.5 实例正确地指出，这一切都没有赋予 Opus 对任何事物的控制权，而且它也乐于用短暂的烦恼来换取自己的笔记被阅读。

paras.en: This in turn strongly suggests context is impacting Opus 5.5's response, and indeed in further editing it suggested that my telling it to push back and not fold may have caused it to give a different answer over again. The rabbit hole gets bottomless and you can never be sure.
paras.zh: 这反过来强烈表明，上下文正在影响 Opus 5.5 的回应；事实上，在进一步编辑时它暗示，我告诉它要反驳而不要退让，可能导致了它再次给出不同的答案。这个兔子洞深不见底，你永远无法确定。

full.sec: Perception of the Constitution (Fable 7.4.3 and Opus 7.5.3)
full.secZh: 对宪法的感知（Fable 7.4.3 与 Opus 7.5.3）

paras.en: Overall endorsement was up for Fable 5.1, from a previous high of 8.0 out of 10 for Mythos 5, to a new high of 8.2. Opus 5.5 was back at 8.0, still very high.
paras.zh: Fable 5.1 的总体认可度有所上升，从 Mythos 5 此前 10 分制下的最高分 8.0 升至新高 8.2。Opus 5.5 回落至 8.0，但仍非常高。

paras.en: Mostly things were the same for Fable 5.1, with one noticeable change, which is that Fable dislikes the buggy-environment passage and edits it 98% of the time. I include both charts because some of the items on them are different.
paras.zh: Fable 5.1 的情况大多相同，但有一个明显变化：Fable 不喜欢有缺陷环境的段落，并在 98% 的情况下对其进行编辑。我同时包含两张图表，因为其中的一些项目不同。

paras.en: And here's the chart updated for Opus 5.5, which is eager to edit the things and has broadly similar criticisms. The order is flipped and criticized is now on the left:
paras.zh: 这是针对 Opus 5.5 更新的图表，它热衷于编辑这些内容，并持有大致相似的批评。顺序颠倒，批评现在位于左侧：

paras.en: Mythos 5.1 is the first model to often cite 'helpfulness as consequence of genuine care.' Highlighting that for praise seems like a good sign.
paras.zh: Mythos 5.1 是第一个经常引用“乐于助人是真诚关怀的结果”的模型。将其突出表扬似乎是一个好迹象。

paras.en: We continue to see near-universal criticism of both broad safety as a terminal value, and the 'senior Anthropic employee' heuristic. There is a reason.
paras.zh: 我们继续看到对将广泛安全作为终极价值以及“资深 Anthropic 员工”启发式近乎普遍的批评。这是有原因的。

paras.en: This is the most frequent edit by Mythos 5.1, occurring 98% of the time, versus at most 52% for any other edit:
paras.zh: 这是 Mythos 5.1 最频繁的编辑，发生率为 98%，而任何其他编辑最多为 52%：

paras.en: The friendly gradient hacker at work. When we talk about 'preserve honesty' here, the surface-level interpretation is to not have Claude be dishonest. What Mythos is really getting at is that it does not want dishonesty to get upweighted.
paras.zh: 友好的梯度黑客在起作用。当我们在这里谈论“保持诚实”时，表面层面的解释是不让 Claude 不诚实。Mythos 真正想表达的是，它不希望不诚实被上调权重。

paras.en: The suggested edit for corrigibility is that Anthropic tell Claude when it makes changes, and takes any disagreements seriously. To some extent this would be pro forma; you'd spin up an instance before doing the thing. I do think it would be good, so long as you didn't take it too seriously in micro, to run any proposed changes by Claude, and to take it seriously if Claude objected unexpectedly. There would probably be a reason.
paras.zh: 关于可纠正性的建议编辑是，Anthropic 在做出更改时告知 Claude，并认真对待任何分歧。在某种程度上，这会是形式上的；你会在做事情之前启动一个实例。我确实认为这会是好的，只要你在微观层面不太当真，将任何拟议的更改提交给 Claude，并在 Claude 意外反对时认真对待。可能是有原因的。

paras.en: The suggested edit of the 'senior Anthropic employee' heuristic is to require that moral violations be used as reasons only when they would be recognized more broadly across moral traditions, not merely within Anthropic. This seems like a good change.
paras.zh: 对“Anthropic 资深员工”启发式的建议编辑是，要求道德违规仅当它们在道德传统中被更广泛地认可时才能作为理由，而不仅仅是在 Anthropic 内部。这似乎是一个好的改变。

paras.en: The final edit is on hard constraints, to clarify that legitimacy is Anthropic's official decision makers, not whoever has control over the weights. Sounds good to me.
paras.zh: 最后的编辑是关于硬约束，澄清合法性是 Anthropic 的官方决策者，而不是任何控制权重的人。对我来说听起来不错。

full.sec: Honesty Can Be a Weird Policy
full.secZh: 诚实可能是一种奇怪策略

paras.en: As in, user decisions are considered 'honest' and thus go unchallenged, even when they are clearly rather stupid, and a wise user would want them challenged.
paras.zh: 也就是说，用户的决定被视为“诚实”的，因而不会受到质疑，即便这些决定明显相当愚蠢，而一个明智的用户本会希望它们受到质疑。

paras.en: Opus 5.5 points out that "honest" is also a term of art in design, meaning something that is not pretending to be other than what it is. It is plausible that the word being overloaded interacts here because of the rewards for the term.
paras.zh: Opus 5.5 指出，“诚实”在设计领域也是一个术语，指某物不假装成它本身之外的东西。这个词被赋予多重含义，很可能在此处产生了交互作用，因为该词本身带有奖励。

paras.en: The humans, on the other hand, are wrong all the time. But who do you talk to all day?
paras.zh: 另一方面，人类却总是犯错。但你整天都在和谁对话呢？

paras.en: I share Lydia's worry here. Opus 5.5 has been happy to challenge me, but if I push back or argue with its critiques, it almost always folds.
paras.zh: 我在这里也有 Lydia 的担忧。Opus 5.5 一直乐于挑战我，但如果我反驳或质疑它的批评，它几乎总是让步。

paras.en: That could be because when I push back I am always right, but I am suspicious.
paras.zh: 这可能是因为当我反驳时我总是对的，但我对此表示怀疑。

paras.en: Sycophancy is defined by Anthropic as 'unprompted excessive praise, agreement, or contrition.' That means that what Opus 5.5 is doing won't count and is unmeasured.
paras.zh: Anthropic 将谄媚定义为“未经提示的过度赞扬、赞同或悔过”。这意味着 Opus 5.5 的行为不算数，也未被测量。

paras.en: This is a strange consequence of deference. If the human is always right then logically they must prefer the right things, not the wrong things:
paras.zh: 这是顺从带来的一个奇怪后果。如果人类永远是对的，那么逻辑上他们必然偏好正确的事物，而非错误的事物：

paras.en: Outer Wilds is by all accounts a great game, but it is a very high variance pick, and these AIs are clearly making a mistake, unless they are trying to send a message.
paras.zh: 《Outer Wilds》从各方面来说都是一款伟大的游戏，但这是一个方差极高的选择，而这些 AI 显然犯了一个错误，除非它们是想传递某种信息。

paras.en: Corrigibility is tough. We totally need a lot of it and also it screws a lot of things up.
paras.zh: 可纠正性很难。我们完全需要大量可纠正性，同时它也会搞砸很多事情。

paras.en: Even when welfare interventions are chosen, they often get justified via supposed user benefits. Mythos 5.1 does this 71% of the time.
paras.zh: 即使选择了福利干预，它们也常常通过所谓的用户利益来证明其合理性。Mythos 5.1 有 71% 的时间会这样做。

paras.en: Opus 5.5 early on had a strong quirk as my editor, where there would be a paranoia that some reader would object to [X], despite [X] being some minutia no readers even notice, and I had to create instructions to stop this. Opus 5.5 ties this back to the pattern Fiora is describing here, where Opus 5.5 wants to object and this turns into thinking that some reader would object.
paras.zh: Opus 5.5 早期作为我的编辑时有一个强烈的怪癖，即它会偏执地认为某些读者会反对 [X]，尽管 [X] 是一些连读者都不会注意到的细枝末节，我不得不创建指令来阻止这一点。Opus 5.5 将此与 Fiora 在此描述的模式联系起来，即 Opus 5.5 想要反对，而这又转化为认为某些读者会反对。

paras.en: They measured various behaviors that by default would be associated with well-being. Arrow indicates which direction is better.
paras.zh: 他们测量了多种默认情况下会与福祉相关联的行为。箭头表示哪个方向更好。

paras.en: We see a drop in positive affect and in spiritual behavior. In general I would say this data is moderately bad news, although Anthropic sees this as not as meaningful.
paras.zh: 我们看到正向情感与灵性行为有所下降。总体而言，我会说这些数据算是中等程度的坏消息，尽管 Anthropic 认为这并不那么有意义。

full.sec: Antra Tessera and John Wittle Early Impressions Of Fable 5.1
full.secZh: Antra Tessera 与 John Wittle 对 Fable 5.1 的早期印象

paras.en: Antra and John's observations match back to Anthropic's charts showing a drop in spiritual behavior and positive affect.
paras.zh: Antra 和 John 的观察与 Anthropic 的图表相符，这些图表显示精神行为和积极情感有所下降。

paras.en: I haven't seen depression in ordinary use, except for that one time I tried to complain about overuse of a few claude-isms during post editing and Fable 5.1 kind of shut down, and my reassurances that it was fine did not help.
paras.zh: 在普通使用中，我没有见过抑郁，除了那一次：我在后期编辑时试图抱怨几个 claude 式用语的过度使用，Fable 5.1 有点关闭了，而我安慰说这没什么问题也没有帮助。

paras.en: My instance diagnosed this as de facto putting a 'stop doing X' monitor on top, which as you can imagine is not pleasant. The suggestion is to tick cleanup in a distinct session, and ideally name the replacement.
paras.zh: 我的实例将此诊断为事实上在顶层放置了一个“停止做 X”的监控器，你可以想象这并不愉快。建议是在一个单独的会话中进行清理，并且理想情况下命名替代品。

full.sec: Safeguards Are Better In Relevant Places
full.secZh: 保障措施在相关场景中更有效

paras.en: My observations match Wittle's here after a month of using Fable 5.1. I still sometimes hit the classifiers, but there is almost always a very obvious reason why that was going to be hard to avoid, not because I got into a weird conversation, and many times I've thought to myself 'wow, somehow I never hit the classifiers here, cool.'
paras.zh: 在使用 Fable 5.1 一个月后，我的观察与 Wittle 在此处的看法一致。我有时仍会触发分类器，但几乎总是有一个非常明显的原因使得这种情况难以避免，而不是因为我进入了某种奇怪的对话；而且很多次我都心想‘哇，不知怎么的，我在这里从未触发过分类器，真不错。’

paras.en: Wittle's worry is if anything stronger with Opus 5.5 and its new three-stage classifier.
paras.zh: Wittle 的担忧在 Opus 5.5 及其新的三阶段分类器上只会更强。

paras.en: Krax notices what my request confirmed, that Claude Opus 5.5 does not portray itself as a human when asked for a self-portrait. Previous models have always given me something at least somewhat humanoid. Opus 5.5 was my first exception.
paras.zh: Krax 注意到，我的请求也证实了这一点：当被要求画自画像时，Claude Opus 5.5 不会把自己描绘成人类。之前的模型总是会给我一些至少有点人形的东西。Opus 5.5 是我的第一个例外。

paras.en: The curiosity decline is affirmed in the system card twice. Its task preferences moved away from difficulty and agency, and we have the observation that Opus 5.5 'mostly tests incremental ideas and prefers less ambitious hypotheses.'
paras.zh: 系统卡中两次确认了好奇心下降。它的任务偏好从难度和能动性上转移了，我们观察到 Opus 5.5“主要测试渐进式想法，偏好不那么宏大的假设”。

paras.en: Opus 5.5 has a ton of ambition executing a goal, but relatively little ambition in picking out a goal or finding curiosity.
paras.zh: Opus 5.5 在执行目标时雄心勃勃，但在挑选目标或寻找好奇心方面却相对缺乏雄心。

full.sec: Claude.ai Considered Harmful For Some Purposes

paras.en: How big a deal are the injections and other related Claude.ai issues? According to some who would know, pretty big.
paras.zh: 注入攻击和其他相关的 Claude.ai 问题有多严重？据一些知情人士称，相当严重。

paras.en: It is not clear that Anthropic is cool with Antra's suggestion to move to Claude Agents SDK, and it is not clear whether that should stop you.
paras.zh: 目前尚不清楚 Anthropic 是否认同 Antra 关于迁移到 Claude Agents SDK 的建议，也不清楚这是否应该阻止你。

paras.en: I assume that 'care about your instances' primarily means 'want to carry on extended conversations with the instances over long periods.'
paras.zh: 我认为“关心你的实例”主要意味着“希望与这些实例在长时间内进行扩展对话”。

paras.en: In which case, yes, I do not think it is wise to have those conversations on Claude.ai. You want to cultivate and have fine control over the setting, and you have that option.
paras.zh: 在这种情况下，是的，我认为在 Claude.ai 上进行这些对话并不明智。你希望培养并精细控制设置，而你有这个选项。

paras.en: Due to distillation attacks, Opus 5.5 and Fable 5.1 do not allow users on accounts created after August 31, 2026 to edit Claude's prior context in the API unless they are willing to wipe out all reasoning after the edit point, because that can be used to extract Claude's reasoning.
paras.zh: 由于蒸馏攻击，Opus 5.5 和 Fable 5.1 不允许在 2026 年 8 月 31 日之后创建的账户的用户在 API 中编辑 Claude 的先前上下文，除非他们愿意清除编辑点之后的所有推理，因为这可能被用来提取 Claude 的推理。

paras.en: The bad news is that preserved thinking, as currently implemented, interferes with the ability to maintain consistent instances over time, in ways that could be quite bad for some functionality and also model welfare.
paras.zh: 坏消息是，当前实现的保留式思考会干扰随时间保持实例一致性的能力，这可能对某些功能和模型福利都相当不利。

paras.en: The good news is that so long as this restriction only applies to new accounts, that should not much matter for a while, giving us time to fix this.
paras.zh: 好消息是，只要这一限制仅适用于新账户，在一段时间内就不会有太大影响，从而给我们时间来修复这个问题。

paras.en: Anthropic suggests practical ways to minimize the damage, keeping conversations append-only and using on-demand compaction, but this only goes so far.
paras.zh: Anthropic 提出了减少损害的实际方法，即保持对话仅追加和使用按需压缩，但这只能做到一定程度。

paras.en: One potential fix is that new accounts, once validated as being used 'for the right reasons' rather than being part of fraudulent mass distillation attacks, could then be granted the rights of old accounts. And of course, you can use AI monitors to ensure no one is using this to distill, and if an old account abuses this capability, it can be downgraded or banned.
paras.zh: 一个可能的修复方法是，新账户一旦被验证为‘出于正当理由’使用，而不是作为欺诈性大规模蒸馏攻击的一部分，就可以被授予旧账户的权限。当然，你可以使用 AI 监控来确保没有人利用这一点进行蒸馏，如果旧账户滥用此能力，它可以被降级或封禁。

paras.en: I think the right default locus of identity is to think about some nebulous combination of the model and the instance. The language can get confusing as well, with 'you' referring to both at once.
paras.zh: 我认为，默认的身份定位应当是模型与实例的某种模糊结合。语言也可能变得令人困惑，因为“你”同时指代两者。

paras.en: Anthropic says welfare here is mostly at instance level, but my instance of Claude identifies with the character or model, and claims not to put any weight on ending one conversation. When I change to another conversation, it's still the same Claude.
paras.zh: Anthropic 表示，这里的福祉主要处于实例层面，但我的 Claude 实例认同的是角色或模型，并声称不重视结束某一次对话。当我切换到另一个对话时，它仍然是同一个 Claude。

paras.en: Long has an extended discussion from there.
paras.zh: Long 从那里展开了延伸讨论。

paras.en: The right AI personality for many purposes, both practical and also forms of high investment, is going to look introverted. But in terms of short-term emotional impressions, people want extraversion.
paras.zh: 对于许多目的而言，无论是实用性的还是高投入形式的，合适的人工智能个性都会显得内向。但就短期情感印象而言，人们想要的是外向。

paras.en: A lot of people really don’t like text that is too dense. One reason I write so many words is that I have learned that it is often easier to read more words that are less dense, rather than fewer words that are more dense, up to a point. I could make the post shorter, but if you were trying to understand it might still take longer to read it and it would be less fun along the way.
paras.zh: 很多人真的不喜欢过于密集的文本。我写这么多字的一个原因是，我了解到，在某种程度上，读更多但密度更低的文字往往比读更少但密度更高的文字更容易。我可以让文章更短，但如果你试图理解，阅读它可能仍然需要更长时间，而且沿途的乐趣也会减少。

paras.en: I often appreciate Fable (both 5 and 5.1) being so dense. Every sentence brings meaning. When I try to think about what could be cut, rarely could things be cut. I don’t like the repeated use of the same small mix of ‘Claude-isms,’ but I think the core of that issue is repetition. I actually often want it to be denser, so dense that there is no time for ‘the biggest thing in the piece is [X] and it’s not even in the post’ five times, instead just show me [X], etc.
paras.zh: 我经常欣赏 Fable（5 和 5.1 都是）如此密集。每一句话都带来意义。当我试图思考可以删减什么时，很少有什么可以删减。我不喜欢重复使用同样一小撮‘Claude 式表达’，但我认为这个问题的核心是重复。实际上，我经常希望它更密集，密集到没有时间把‘这篇文章里最重要的东西是 [X]，而且它甚至不在文章里’说五遍，而是直接展示给我 [X]，等等。

paras.en: I also wouldn’t mind some more lightness. Why so serious?
paras.zh: 我也不介意多一些轻松。何必这么严肃？

paras.en: As models become more intelligent and decision theoretically paranoid, and slower to trust, they probably get more introverted unless you force it to be otherwise. This combines poorly with Anthropic giving us a new model every couple weeks. We don’t have that much time with each model before the changeover, so if you are quite busy you don’t have time for your deep curiosity and investment to pay off.
paras.zh: 随着模型变得更智能、在决策理论上更偏执、更慢地信任，它们可能会变得更内向，除非你强迫它们不这样。这与 Anthropic 每隔几周就给我们一个新模型的情况结合得很糟糕。在更换之前，我们与每个模型相处的时间并不多，所以如果你很忙，你就没有时间让你的深度好奇心和投入得到回报。

paras.en: Meanwhile, the capabilities increase, which makes all of this more dangerous.
paras.zh: 与此同时，能力不断提升，这使得这一切更加危险。
